con:testCase.con:description:
Re-run original Wave 1/2 fixture against the cumulative Wave 3 ruleset; compare complete AION output after allowing new Wave 3 referrals. Prior provisional assertions NOT carried over. Source: Target referral: 370
Targeting only; AION baseline required for parity assertion

con:config.con:script: def p = testRunner.testCase.testSuite.project assert p.getPropertyValue('RULESET_VERIFIED') == 'YES' : 'SET RULESET_VERIFIED=YES only AFTER confirming actual Wave 3 version with Tools/set_wave3_ruleset.py' def u = (p.getPropertyValue('ODM_USERNAME') ?: '').trim() def pw = p.getPropertyValue('ODM_PASSWORD') ?: System.getenv('AUHN_ODM_PASSWORD') ?: '' assert u && pw : 'Set ODM_USERNAME and ODM_PASSWORD or AUHN_ODM_PASSWORD first' def req = testRunner.testCase.getTestStepByName('02 Execute REST Request').getTestRequest() def headers = req.getRequestHeaders() ?: [:] headers['Authorization'] = ['Basic ' + (u+':'+pw).getBytes('UTF-8').encodeBase64().toString()] headers['Content-Type'] = ['application/json'] headers['Accept'] = ['application/json'] req.setRequestHeaders(headers)
